note: Decolonial work on tropical representation of Black and brown women; solo show Syracuse University Art Museum 2025. Birth year not web-verified. Instagram handle not found in results.

name: Peter Minshall
note: Carnival designer (Hummingbird 1974, Paradise Lost 1976, Callaloo trilogy); designed opening ceremonies for Atlanta Olympics 1996 and World Cups. Living status not confirmed in results.

name: Ibrahim Miranda
gallery: Zane Bennett Gallery (Santa Fe); Diana Lowenstein (Miami) listed in results
note: Born Pinar del Rio; Mapaglifos map series; Krakow Print Triennial award 2003; works in MoMA and National Gallery of Art; professor. Gallery relationships not confirmed as current.

name: Madsen Mompremier
note: Born Gonaives; Vodou lwa paintings (Erzulie/La Sirene), pupil of Gerard Valcin; in Fowler Museum 2011 show and Five Decades of Haitian Painting. Wife Ersulie Mompremier, also a painter, died in 2010 earthquake.

name: Tony Monsanto
note: Died 25 Jan 2014 in Curacao; studied Rijksakademie Amsterdam and TU Delft; returned to Curacao 1999; work in Central Bank of Curacao collection.

name: Philip Moore
note: Self-taught; designed the 1763 Monument in Georgetown; Princeton artist-in-residence; 150+ works in Guyana national collection. Death year disputed: 2012 (Wikipedia) vs 2014 (UWI archive).

name: Arnaldo Morales
note: Born Ponce; NYC since 1996; interactive mechanical sculptures from recycled industrial materials; Joan Mitchell and NYFA fellowships.
